title: Conditional Density Lift and Dual-Witness Xi Functional
description: This paper defines a secondary diagnostic functional, Xi, for an l1-primary finite obstruction framework. The construction begins with the quotient obstruction magnitude Phi_1, inherited from the finite cochain complex C0(P) -> C1(P), and introduces a conditional l1-to-density lift using a normalized square-root map into rank-1 density matrices that preserves normalized absolute coordinate weights and real amplitudes without independent phases (discarding total mass and common global sign). For obstructed classes (Phi_1 > 0), the paper selects canonical primal and dual representatives through successive coordinate minimization on the compact optimal face relative to a declared edge ordering, and defines Xi as the trace-norm distance between the density of the selected primal residual h1* and the density of the optimal dual witness phi*. For unobstructed classes (Phi_1 = 0), Xi = 0 by declared convention. For optimal pairs, LP complementary slackness enforces Xi < 1 strictly. Xi is evaluated strictly as a tertiary tie-breaker under a tiered priority policy when Phi_1 and Gamma_2 are tied within tolerance and boundary guardrail R_cl <= R_max is satisfied.
